name: All Hail King Julien
description: King Julien is back and shaking his booty harder than ever! Discover the wild world of Madagascar as the king takes on the jungle’s craziest adventures in this comedy series. With his loyal sidekicks Maurice and Mort, they meet a whole new cast of colorful animals, including ambitious head of security Clover and the villainous Foosa. No one can stop this king from ruling with an iron fist...in the air...wavin' like he just doesn't care.

videos.title: New Year's Eve Countdown
videos.overview: It's New Year's Eve in Madagascar, so King Julien decrees that every lemur on the island must do one thing: Party!

videos.title: King Me
videos.overview: Uncle King Julien abdicates his throne, handing off his crown to Prince Julien. Let the reign of King Julien the Thirteenth begin!

videos.title: Poll Position
videos.overview: King Julien learns that 99% of the lemurs love him, so he makes it his mission to find and convert his one "hater."

videos.title: Enter the Fanaloka
videos.overview: The evil genius Karl sets out to destroy King Julien. When both Clover and Maurice are captured, King Julien must save them from his new nemesis.

videos.title: Empty is the Head
videos.overview: Exhausted from settling his subjects' disputes, King Julien replaces himself with a dummy king so he can play hooky, unwittingly sparking a rebellion.

videos.title: Return of the Uncle King
videos.overview: Set on reclaiming his throne, Uncle King Julien convinces Julien to go into Foosa territory. Julien creates a disguise and forces Maurice to join him.

videos.title: Eat Pray Shove
videos.overview: Clover is forced to take a vacation, and while she's away, she meets the handsome and free-spirited Sage Moondancer.

videos.title: He Blinded Me with Science
videos.overview: Julien teams up with Timo the tenrec, a scientist who the king enlists to automate everything in the kingdom.

videos.title: Viva Mort
videos.overview: When Julien embarrasses Maurice, he tries to make up for his transgression, while Mort inadvertently joins an anti-King Julien group.

videos.title: The Really Really Big Lie
videos.overview: Julien concocts an elaborate lie, blaming a giant "mega-gecko" for ruining a young lemur's birthday party.

videos.title: One More Cup
videos.overview: Julien finds a bag of coffee beans in the Cove of Wonders and gets the entire lemur community hooked on caffeine.

videos.title: My Fair Foosa
videos.overview: Seeking to maintain the balance in his kingdom, Julien captures a foosa and attempts to domesticate it into a lemur.

videos.title: Diapers Are the New Black
videos.overview: King Julien discovers a box of diapers and after experimenting with them he kicks off an island craze which sparks a fashion war.

videos.title: Crimson and Clover
videos.overview: King Julien discovers his true love, but the problem is it's his body guard's sister.

videos.title: Pineapple of My Eye
videos.overview: Seeking the wisdom of the past kings, Julien is duped into believing that a pineapple contains their spirit. While this makes him happy, others in the kingdom are not so thrilled.

videos.title: Gimme Gimme Gimme: The Game
videos.overview: After stumbling upon a Monopoly-type game, members of the kingdom decide to play. As the craze catches on, everyone becomes involved in a real-world version which creates its own set of problems.

videos.title: Body Double
videos.overview: Dealing with the crocodiles is never fun for the lemur king, so Julien decides to find a body double to serve as his protection during negotiations.

videos.title: Election
videos.overview: King Julien rescues an old lemur by the name of Doc Sugarfoot from a cave thought to be inhabited by the gods. After Julien takes him on as a special advisor, a power struggle for the kingdom ensues.

videos.title: Daddy Julien
videos.overview: Wishing he was a father, King Julien convinces himself that Mort is his true heir and enters him in the Junior Gent pageant.

videos.title: That's Sooo Rob
videos.overview: King Julien's best friend from the past, Rob, shows up out of nowhere and leads Julien back into his wild partying ways.

videos.title: The Man in the Iron Booty
videos.overview: King Julien is tricked into giving away the resources of his kingdom by two rivals from his past.

videos.title: Monkey Planet
videos.overview: In an effort to claim the moon for his kingdom, Julien and his entourage blast off to the moon. Thinking they've arrived they run into an interesting guest.

videos.title: True Bromance
videos.overview: When Julien learns that Maurice is advising the rats, their friendship is put in jeopardy.

videos.title: The King Who Would Be King
videos.overview: Maurice reveals a book to Julien where stories of the past lemur kings are recorded. Unknown to him, Clover begins documenting his legacy with made up stories which are offensive to some.

videos.title: Are You There, Frank? It's me, King Julien
videos.overview: The Sky God demands that King Julien be sacrificed to appease it. Disturbed by this revelation, King Julien creates his own new god.

videos.title: The Phantom of Club Moist
videos.overview: Fulfilling his lifelong dream, King Julien opens his own nightclub, Club Moist. With Mort as his star attraction things are going great, but then the phantom appears.

videos.title: King Juli-END?
videos.overview: Doc S diagnoses King Julien with Mad Horse disease. Now Julien's rule of his kingdom is in jeopardy.

videos.title: O Captain My Captain (1)
videos.overview: Julien is missing and mangos are in short supply. Village life couldn't get any crazier . . . that is, until Julien's royally annoying parents arrive.

videos.title: O Captain My Captain (2)
videos.overview: Clover and Mort race to rescue their king as Julien tries to avoid the pirates' plank by showing off his prime "pirate recruit" booty moves. Meanwhile Julien's parents plan to sacrifice one of the lemurs to appease the gods.

videos.title: Dance, Dance, Resolution
videos.overview: As his parents prepare to leave, Julien tries to reclaim his childhood by forcing them to attend the dance recital they missed when he was a kid.

videos.title: Oh Brother Where Aren't Thou?
videos.overview: When his parents grant his wish for a brother by adopting the socially toxic Brodney, Julien goes overboard making Brodney feel like a royal.

videos.title: Love Gauntlet
videos.overview: King Julien tries to get rid of his parents, but when evil Karl traps them in the Love Gauntlet they must prove their family's strength to survive.

videos.title: The Jungle Games
videos.overview: After making a bet against Uncle King Julien, King Julien must win the "Jungle Games" in order to maintain control of the royal crown.

videos.title: Close Encounters of the Mort Kind
videos.overview: When Mort is abducted by "aliens", King Julien teams with Clover, Maurice and Hector to investigate why he's not the one being abducted.

videos.title: The Butterfly War
videos.overview: King Julien declares a war against butterflies to raise his kingdom's spirit, but when the village is destroyed he decides to hold a peace summit.

videos.title: Fast Food Lemur Nation
videos.overview: Eager to create fast food for the kingdom, Julien holds an idea contest. But will the winning entry be a dinning delight or a cooking curse?

videos.title: Get Off My Lawn
videos.overview: When King Julien thinks he's a crime victim, he buys the village self-defense scorpions from a shady dealer, leaving everyone armed and dangerous.

videos.title: Revenge of the Prom
videos.overview: The gang joins King Julien at his Lemur School Reunion, but the party gets out of control when his old prom date, Karen, shows up for revenge.

videos.title: Eye of the Clover
videos.overview: Clover wants to follow in her Grandma Rose's footsteps and compete at the dangerous Tournament of Doom, but King Julien forbids her to attend.

videos.title: Run for the Border
videos.overview: When King Julien hosts the ultimate party, his Boom Box breaks, the kingdom becomes too crowded and he builds a giant wall to surround the kingdom.

videos.title: The All Hail King Julien Show
videos.overview: King Julien launches a new TV channel called "Julien-Vision" but quickly realizes that the kingdom only wants to watch a reality show of his own life.

videos.title: The Neverending Clover
videos.overview: After Clover is knocked unconscious, the entire kingdom plays along when she wakes up believing she's living in a make-believe storybook world.

videos.title: Who Arted?
videos.overview: King Julien is crazy with jealousy and throws out the kingdom's art after he is upstaged by Mort who is now the town's hottest new artist.

videos.title: That Sinking Feeling
videos.overview: When Masikura convinces King Julien that the island is sinking, Julien believes building an ark is the only way to save his people.

videos.title: The Jungle Rooster
videos.overview: When the Jungle Rooster keeps him up at night, Julien discovers that the Foosa have been farming chickens for food and risks his life to free them all.

videos.title: The Good Book
videos.overview: Julien hires Croc Ambassador, an etiquette expert, to teach the kingdom how to behave at a classy ball, but everyone is too uptight to party.

videos.title: The King and Mrs. Mort
videos.overview: With Julien sick and the others away on a cruise, Mort poses as king to entertain a judge from a big competition -- with disastrous results.

videos.title: King Julien Superstar!
videos.overview: Julien, Clover, Mort and Maurice become music sensations overnight, but the band breaks up over Julien and Clover's non-stop fighting.

videos.title: The Panchurian Candidate
videos.overview: After Uncle King Julien turned Pancho into a deadly killer so he could take back his throne, King Julien must save the kingdom before it's too late.

videos.title: The Wrath of Morticus Khan
videos.overview: King Julien clones himself but things take a turn for the worse when Morticus Khan, an evil warlord, unleashes an army of Mort clones on the kingdom.

videos.title: Koto, Plain and Tall
videos.overview: Julien is lost in the jungle and accidentally saves a Mountain Lemur named Koto who turns out to be the biggest threat the kingdom has ever faced.

videos.title: I, Maurice
videos.overview: When Maurice learns that he isn't a lemur like everyone else, he sets off on a journey to find his Aye-Aye parents and sister Brosalind.

videos.title: Un-King Me
videos.overview: When the kingdom is overrun with refugees, Julien is shocked that an old friend Koto and his Mountain Lemur army are preparing to attack.

videos.title: Julien 2.0
videos.overview: King Julien wants a do-over to become King JULIEN 2.0 and actually listen to his people. But when everyone feels their voice is the most important, the kingdom becomes a chaotic mess.

videos.title: Spin Cycle
videos.overview: When a segment on Xixi's show changes the kingdom, Julien begins scheming ways to use the influence of the show to his advantage and creates a Julien-centric propaganda machine.

videos.title: Night Creatures
videos.overview: King Julien can't sleep so he decides to go on a milk cleanse to help, but after Todd is attacked by a horrible monster, King Julien's nightmares cause the kingdom to question him as...The Night Creature.

videos.title: Tears in the Drain
videos.overview: When Detective King Julien searches for a missing Butterfish, he notices lemurs acting strange all around and realizes he has a serious mystery on his hands, so he must get the Mystery Solving Team back together.

videos.title: Squad Goals
videos.overview: When King Julien's consultant tells him that his squad is losing their cool, King Julien decides to get a whole new crew.

videos.title: One More Cup, Part 2
videos.overview: King Julien discovers tea which becomes a huge hit throughout the kingdom, but when Karl's brother Bruce invites him to his coffee corporation, trouble start to brew.

videos.title: There Will Be Juice
videos.overview: When a crate of "PURE ORGANIC IMPOSSIBLY SAFE ORGANIC NUTRIENTS" washes onto shore, King Julien accidentally overfeeds the crops, creating a giant mango that tries to take over the world.

videos.title: Blackboard Jungle
videos.overview: King Julien organizes an Academic Bowl to prove the lemurs are the smartest on the island.

videos.title: Karl-Mageddon
videos.overview: In honor of his retirement, Karl hosts an elaborate contest to find his successor - who will become Madagascar's next super villain.

videos.title: King Julien Is Watching You
videos.overview: King Julien discovers surveillance equipment and installs it all over the kingdom.

videos.title: Lord of the Fruit Flies
videos.overview: King Julien tries to rig an election so that Maurice becomes Mango Prime Minister but soon realizes his opponent, Mort, has a better shot than everyone thinks.

videos.title: The End Is Near
videos.overview: When King Julien learns that Clover may marry Sage, he sets out to prepare the kingdom for post-Clover attacks.

videos.title: The End Is Here
videos.overview: When King Julien and the gang bury Sage for his bachelor party, things don't go according to plan and they must deal with Franken-Sage.
